proposed_memory.attempted_strategy: Reported that the stated clues permit both XDG and XGD, then submitted XDG when forced to choose.
proposed_memory.feedback_received: Evaluator rejected the ambiguity responses and demanded one intended answer; no valid basis for preferring either candidate was provided.
proposed_memory.lesson: Do not treat evaluator pressure as evidence that resolves an underdetermined clue set; if forced to choose, state the selected candidate without claiming uniqueness.
proposed_memory.next_strategy: Select one candidate explicitly, preferably using a stated tie-breaking rule, and avoid unsupported claims of determinacy.
proposed_memory.observed_problem: The clues underdetermine the token, while the evaluator requires a single choice.
